nom: TATCHA The Indigo Cleansing Balm Moisturizing Makeup Remover

avis.texte: Me gusta deja la piel muy bien. Solo que tengo que aplicar dos veces para una limpieza total

I have sensitive, acne-prone skin, and wear makeup everyday. This product easily removes all of my makeup, doesn't irritate my eyes, and hasn't caused any breakouts. I would definitely recommend this as a first cleanse and makeup remover!

Love this balm! It truly breaks down all makeup while cleansing the skin. I wear brow gel and mascara almost daily and it gets that off with ease. If I'm exhausted and lazy at night, I sometimes use just this product (warm water + Clean Skin towel after) to cleanse my skin. I was a longtime makeup wipe user (gross, I know) and I'm so glad I made the switch to this balm!

avis.titre: Best oil free makeup removing balm
avis.texte: I suffer from cystic acne, so I try to avoid skincare products containing oil. This is the first makeup removing balm that I've tried and loved that is oil free! It removed all my makeup and helped reduce some redness on my cheeks but with consistent use. My only wish is that it was a tad bit more moisturizing. Regardless, this has become a new skincare staple for me!
Shelby in the video says in the end that "you'll never want to go back to to anything else" and I was like, Elf, Drunk Elephant, Byoma, etc.. lol
This balm really does an amazing job removing waterproof eye makeup and has become one of my favorites. If you use with a cloth to remove, it is seamless.

I stuck to Dermalogica for the longest time. Just got complacent about it never thought to try another brand until my face suddenly started to disagree with it. I thought their pre-cleanse oil was good. It's not. It's garbage compared to this stuff. Tatchas cleansing balm lasts me way longer, get every speck of mascara off, and leaves my eye area totally clean. I don't have to use another round or a cleanser on my eyes like I did with Dermalogica's. When I wear a full face, it absolutely melts everything off and let's my cleanser really get in there and do it's thing. It's got a very faint scent to it. A clean, hint of floral scent that is not offensive. I cannot recommend this stuff enough.
This works well but ive tried other cleansing balms that work just as well for half the price. Save your money!

This is the first Tatcha product I've tried. It's very nice. Doesn't leave a greasy film on your skin like some makeup removing balms. The packaging is very high end. The only negative is that it takes a little extra effort to remove my mascara (not a waterproof formula). Other than that, I love it.

I bought this product as a trial mini awhile back and I was blown away at how fast it melts my makeup off and cleanses my skin so so cleanly! You only need a small amount, like a nickel size, I very gently tap my fingers together to spread the product and then apply it slowly and completely all over my face. I was skeptical at first because it feels like it just melts but it is actually melting the makeup off!!! I am so beyond happy to see Ulta sell the brand line Tatcha! Thank you so much for having such great products!!!

This is a great balm to start your cleansing routine. I'm a big fan of double cleansing with balm and a cleanser. Not only does it start working right away, it starts to melt away your makeup, dirt, oil and other impurities and leaves the skin soft, clean and no stripping of your skin barrier. Comes with a little gold disk to scoop just the right amount. This rivals Clinique's Take the Day Off balm. Definitely a good purchase. Try the Tatcha skincare line. Yes, it's a tad pricey, but you can achieve great results with it.

This product does a great job at melting down makeup and being a decent first cleanse, as long as you don't wear waterproof mascara. I have to do an extra cleanse with a different makeup remover on my eyes so it defeats the purpose of using this.
